title: Sum of Squares Decompositions and Rank Bounds for Biquadratic Forms
summary: We study SOS properties of biquadratic forms. For the class of partially symmetric biquadratic forms, we establish necessary and sufficient conditions for positive semi-definiteness and prove that every PSD partially symmetric biquadratic form is a sum of squares of bilinear forms. This extends the known result for fully symmetric biquadratic forms. We describe an efficient computational procedure for constructing SOS decompositions, exploiting the Kronecker-product structure of the associated matrix representation.
